ShengBTE

Accelerate Bench task · Transport, plasma & astronomy

ShengBTE calculates bulk lattice thermal transport from crystal force constants.

Task version1.1.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory6 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

The workflow computes phonons and scattering rates and solves the transport equation at the prescribed temperatures using the relaxation-time approximation and an iterative solver.

Correctness

Per-mode results, conductivity tensors and temperature-dependent outputs must match the reference. The iterative solution must converge.

Timing

The complete MPI run across the prescribed temperatures is timed.

Reported runtime-saving reward

First-run rewards on benchmark v1.1, from the data behind paper Table 1, rounded to one decimal. Failed correctness is distinct from a correct result with zero speedup reward.
